Go HERE for all the info. ) — A bonafide guitar legend by any standard, his band Dinosaur Jr. toured with and influenced many of the bands that defined the 90’s -- bands like Nirvana, Sonic Youth, Mudhoney, and too many others to count. Ask nearly any punk or grunge band from that era (and of today) if they’ve heard of J Mascis, and you’ll get a look like you’re a fool for even having to ask. His association with the Big Muff is well documented as one of the main building blocks of the Dinosaur Jr. sound. So, it is understandable that the Muff experts at Wren and Cuff would be the ones calling when the idea for a signature pedal came about. After more than 2 years in the making, that pedal is finally here. A part-by-part recreation of J’s number one Muff since 1987, this is not just any 70’s EHX Ram’s Head. J’s pedal is an odd bird with parts values that are “incorrect” and component values that have drifted far from their original values during its near-50 year journey.  On the other side of the pedal is a replication of J’s favorite germanium treble booster that he uses to slam the input of said muffer. And nestled in between the two is a wonderfully simple but incredibly useful tool... a second volume knob with a footswitch to let you bounce between two Muff volume outputs! We know you’ll love this collaboration with one of the best masters of fuzz that has ever lived. Specs: Power: 9VDC neg tip adapter or 9V battery Current draw: 8mA Dims: 4.7” x 3.6” x 1.7” Weight: 14.5 oz Read the review! Custom Fuzz Face variant. Part-by-part recreation of J Mascis's personal 1970s Ram's Head Big Muff combined with a germanium Rangemaster-style treble booster. Component values are deliberately 'incorrect'—replicating the drifted values in Mascis's nearly 50-year-old pedal rather than using spec values. Fuzz section has Volume, Tone, and Sustain. Germanium treble booster section with NOS germanium transistor. Second Volume knob with dedicated footswitch allows switching between rhythm and lead output levels. Two-in-one design replicates Mascis's actual signal chain of booster slamming into a Muff. Dinosaur Jr frontman's signature pedal, over two years in development. The drifted component values and germanium boost capture his specific broken-in tone. 8mA draw, 4.7 x 3.6 x 1.7 inches, 14.5 oz.
